title: Pointwise half-power normalization into Mersenne kernels

concepts.label: half-power to Mersenne normalization
concepts.note: At a positive index, binary half-powers and their geometric denominators rewrite exactly into powers of the Mersenne denominator 2^d-1.

concepts.label: squared Mersenne kernel split
concepts.note: The normalized squared kernel separates into first- and second-order reciprocal Mersenne terms.

concepts.label: pointwise versus series boundary
concepts.note: These are finite real-algebra identities used inside Lambert evaluations, not summability or infinite-series conclusions.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For every positive natural d, 2^d-1 is positive and the following real identities hold: (1/2)^d divided by 1-(1/2)^d equals 1/(2^d-1); (1/2)^d divided by (1-(1/2)^d)^2 equals 2^d/(2^d-1)^2; and 2^d/(2^d-1)^2 equals 1/(2^d-1)+1/(2^d-1)^2.
statement_nodes.engine: Positivity of 2^d above one for d>0, followed by denominator nonvanishing, field normalization, and a final ring identity.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: These are elementary geometric-denominator rewrites specialized to base two and the exact Lambert kernels used by the formal development; no novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The identities are pointwise over the real numbers and require d>0. They do not prove summability, justify exchanging infinite sums, evaluate a Lambert series, establish coefficient positivity, decide an achievement-set membership, or imply irrationality for Erdős #249 or #257.

declaration_roles.routing_basis: Exact positivity evidence for the nonvanishing denominators used by all three normalization identities; replaces Z07's zone-only substrate receipt.
Exact pointwise conversion of the first geometric half-power kernel to a reciprocal Mersenne denominator; replaces Z07's zone-only substrate receipt.
Exact pointwise conversion of the squared geometric denominator to the normalized squared Mersenne kernel; replaces Z07's zone-only substrate receipt.
Exact algebraic split of the normalized squared Mersenne kernel into reciprocal first- and second-order terms; replaces Z07's zone-only substrate receipt.
